Alex (Support): Hey @here — escalation from Acme: graphs in Console are stuck on spinner, customer sees 'Failed to load chart' and we get 500s from /internal/analytics/query. They pasted curl output. Can someone triage?
Jenna (CS): Customer called, high priority. Started at ~09:02 UTC, affects a handful of accounts. They said metrics for last 7d and custom time ranges fail.
Alex (Support): Repro steps from customer: 1) Login -> Console -> Project Acme -> Dashboards -> open 'Revenue by region' 2) Switch time range to 7d 3) Spinner -> error toast. They captured request id: req_0a1b2c3d.
Alex (Support): Pasted curl they ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://console.redwood.ai/internal/analytics/query?project=acme&range=7d" -v
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout","request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d"}
```
Diego (Analytics): I see elevated 500/504 error rate on analytics-query between 09:00-09:15 UTC. Traces show backend times spiking at 'query-processor' step, waiting on ClickHouse: SELECT time_bucket... had 8s+ p99.
Priya (Frontend): Frontend just surfaces the 500 and shows toast. We degrade to zeros but customer expects empty state; not great. Quick fix: we can show cached snapshot for 5m while we heal.
Nate (SRE): Noted. I pulled metrics from infra: analytics-query service CPU at 60%, but connection errors to clickhouse from nodes. Connection errors + queue growth. Could be a ClickHouse zone issue.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: analytics-query v1.42.7 by diego at 2026-03-17T08:58:12Z
Diego (Analytics): That deploy coincides with start of errors. The change was a new GROUP BY optimization that expanded query fanout for long time ranges. Rolling back to v1.42.6 for a quick mitigation.
Nate (SRE): Rolling back now. Command:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/analytics-query -n prod --to-revision=2026-03-17-1
```
Nate (SRE): Rollback in progress, pods terminating and new ones starting. Will watch p99 and error rate.
Alex (Support): I'll update customer: "We see a backend change causing timeouts for long-range queries, we're rolling back, ETA ~5-10m."
Diego (Analytics): After rollback error rate dropped ~85% within 90s. ClickHouse connections returned to normal. I'm opening a post-deploy PR to add query cost guardrails for long ranges.
Priya (Frontend): I'll push a small console change to show cached snapshot and clearer CTA to retry; low-risk feature flag.
Jenna (CS): Customer on the phone, they want confirmation when resolved. Alex: ping when fixed so I can call them.
Alex (Support): Will do. Thanks all.
Diego (Analytics): Follow-ups: 1) Add server-side limit/heuristic to reject or rewrite heavy GROUP BY when range > 3d without sampling; 2) Add perf test for v1.42.x changes; 3) Postmortem if rollout caused customer impact.
Nate (SRE): Logged incident in #incidents and assigned sev3. I'll attach graphs and timeline.
Alex (Support): Update: customer confirmed dashboards loading again at 09:12 UTC. I'll close the escalation after 1h of stability.
Jenna (CS): Thx. Marking as resolved from CS side, please keep me posted on postmortem. :white_check_mark:
